translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Yosebe ibu Podiba andagani henego ogo

Isimaleali biaru tigua Yosebe Iyibi dindini haru pu heleagola Podibahanda agali biaru muni mialu Yosebe haru pene. Podiba ogoni ibu kini mamage haga ami agali hearunaga hondo haga haguane howa ibuni Iyibiali dindi tene hene.
Anduane Homogohanda Yosebe baya hangu handaya ho heagola ibugua Podiba andagani howa biyago bibahende bayale hangu hai hene.
Podibahanda handalu hearia Yosebe ibuha Anduane Homogo ibula haru howa ibugua biyago bibahende bayale dege hayago hendene.
Ani biyago hondowa ibugua Yosebehondo lalu, I̱ andagaha bibahende ngoruni handameho habe, lene.
Ogonidagua biyagola Podiba ibu andagaha wiaru bibahende bayale hai hene. Anduane Homogohanda Yosebe handaya ho heagola ani bini. Ibunaga mabu andabi maruale wiarubi ani dege bini.
Aniore biyagola Podiba ibunaga mbirale wiaruni Yosebenaga giha ya hai halu ibu tomo nolenego hangu mitangi biaga hene. Yosebe ibunibi nde baya henene baya mbira halu hongo pururuleore heneya.
Ani heagola Podiba one ibu Yosebe dimagoli ho biruwa lalu, Iya palibiya íbu, lene.
Ani layagola Yosebehanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱naga agali haguane ibugua ibu andagaha ngaru bibahende i̱na hondo holiya ngiai hayago tene i̱ha ko mbira bulubada manda nabi howa ani biyagoni.

Áyu ibunaga mbirale ngaru bibahende ibuni handaya ho holenedagua i̱na kogoni. Ibugua i̱hondo ogo bibe nabibe lalubi mbira nale. Bibahende i̱na hondo hai kogoni. Ai í̠ dege ibuni hangu one bedego. Ibugua i̱hondo í̠la palilibu lalu mbira nalego. Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni howa i̱na mana ko ngubi ogoni bulene nawiore, lene.
Horo bibahendengi howa wali ogoni ibugua Yosebehondo kayu yaba lalu laho wiyagola Yosebe ibu walila mandagi napale ohalu haabo hene.
Horo mbirungi Yosebe ibu andaga tamuha biabe mbira bulene wiyagola anda pene. Ogoningi agali biabe biaga mbira nahe ibuni hangu hene.

Yosebe ibu tamuha anda pu heagola Podiba one biagome aga biagoria minu yani howa lalu, Ai palibiya íbuore bia, lene. Ani lalu hea handala Yosebe ibunaga aga biago wali ogoninaga giha golo ya helalu ibuni ibida tagira pene.
Wali biagome handalu hearia Yosebenaga aga yu wahalu tagira piyagola

ibugua agali biabe bia haga maru hearu olowa lalu, Uru-o ai handadaba. I̱ agalini ibugua Hiburuali haru ibiyagome i̱na mo taga hole o bialu hayadago handadaba. Ibugua i̱ tamu paliagaha anda ibuwa mandagi paliba layagola i̱na hongo howa koaba larugoni.
I̱na hongo howa koaba larugola ibunaga aga i̱ tamuni wia handala gerai lalu ibida piya, lene.
Ani lowa ibugua Yosebenaga aga biago ibu agalini andaga ibiragola walia hole lalu yu biraabo hene.
Ibu agalini andaga ibiyagola bi ala layadagua dege lone lalu, Hiburu igiri biabe bia haga í̠na haru ibirigonime i̱ tamuha anda ibuwa i̱ minulebiya.
Ani biyagola i̱na hongo howa koaba laru handala ibunaga aga i̱ tamuha ibira halu gerai ibida piya, lene.
Yosebenaga agali haguane biagome bi uruni layago hale howa ibu keba gibiore hene.
Ani howa ibugua ami agali hearuhondo lalu, Yosebe minu yalu puwa kininaga garabaya anda wiagoha garabaya helo heladaba, layagola tigua haru puwa helene.

Anigo Anduane Homogo ibu Yosebela haabo howa Yosebehanda biyago mo bayale haga bialu hene. Ani bialu Anduane Homogohanda agali garabaya haru haga heagome Yosebe mitangi bialu hame lelo biamogo bigi bialu hene.
Agali ogoni ibugua Yosebehanda garabaya hearu bibahende handameho helo dabo helene. Ani biyagola Yosebehanda garabaya andaha biabe bulene wiaru bibahende ibugua dege hondo hai helene.
Anduane Homogohanda Yosebe bayuwaore haru heagome biabe ibugua biyaruni aria mbira lone agali haguane biago ibuni handa dai bibe nahe hene.
